mechanics.name: Deep Cut
mechanics.description: Cone tank buster on top 2 aggro

mechanics.name: Boss Jumps Middle
mechanics.description: Boss repositions to center arena. Prepare for next mechanic.

mechanics.name: Flip to A-side/B-side
mechanics.description: Dictates if roles will get hit or if light parties will get hit.

mechanics.name: 2/3/4-snap Twist & Drop the Needle
mechanics.description: The side with the waves will get hit 2, 3, or 4 times based on the cast name.

steps.text: Stand on the side with waves and take the hits
After the specified number of hits, move to the other side to avoid a cleave on the side opposite the waves
After final cleave, move to fixed spots for A-side/B-side:
substeps: DPS plant at intercardinal where you are
Tanks move into the final cleave position

mechanics.name: Disco Infernal
mechanics.description: Raidwide damage. Everyone gets debuffs for upcoming mechanic.

steps.text: Check your debuff timer

mechanics.warning: Check your debuff timer as soon as it appears!

mechanics.name: Funky Floor
mechanics.description: Alternating tiles. Stand on ones that aren't getting hit.

steps.text: Observe the first pattern to identify safe tiles
Based on the first pattern, determine where you will take your spotlight when the debuff resolves

tips: The safe spot pattern repeats - memorize it early for consistent positioning

mechanics.name: Ensemble Assemble
mechanics.description: Spread around the boss in your assigned positions. Boss will alternate in/out throughout the mechanic.

steps.text: Start at max melee in your fan position
Move in/out after each hit based on boss telegraph

mechanics.name: Arcady Night Fever
mechanics.description: Starting out at max melee in your fan, one player will get hit by a cone.

steps.text: First player hit moves to someone else in their role
Second player (opposite role) gets hit
substeps: First player returns to their spot
Second player moves to someone in their role

steps.text: Repeat until all 8 players have been hit, plus one extra follow up on the final player

mechanics.warning: Check the timer for your debuff at the end of this mechanic

mechanics.name: Let's Dance
mechanics.description: Check debuffs for your timer. Go to your position based on the timer.

steps.text: While sticking to your area, dodge the left/right cleaves from the dancers at the north

mechanics.name: Let's Pose
mechanics.description: If you did the last 2 mechs perfectly you get a damage buff, otherwise you take damage.

mechanics.name: Ride the Waves
mechanics.description: Default positions with tank swaps based on which side needs to pull the boss.

steps.text: MT/OT swap depending on what side you need to pull the boss to
substeps: If pulling east: MT goes NE
If pulling west: MT goes NW

mechanics.warning: When adjusting your lane for exa waves, try not to pull the boss away from the other group

mechanics.name: Quarter Beats / Eighth Beats
mechanics.description: Two different position sets based on the cast name.

positions.Quarter Beats: Same as Ride the Waves default positions

mechanics.name: Frogtourage
mechanics.description: Group up in your light parties (G1 NW, G2 SE). Look at the 2 pairs of frogs cutting across the arena.

steps.text: Find the pair that turns out. Where they turn out will be the safe spot
substeps: This will either be North/South or East/West

steps.text: Quarter Beats: Melee's in front, ranged behind in your safespot
Eighth Beats: Use special formation
Rotate clockwise for frog/spotlight as needed
substeps: Group with lower countdowns in spotlights first
Other group be close to the frog and bait the cones away from spotlights

mechanics.name: Let's Dance! Remix
mechanics.description: Same as before with dodging the cleaves displayed at North
mechanics.notes: This time they're faster and include forward/back dodges instead of just left/right.

mechanics.name: Frogtourage (Second)
mechanics.description: Dodge half room cleaves from the two ADS, then from boss.

steps.text: Line yourself up with one ADS and move to the safe spot of the other
Repeat
Dodge half room cleave from boss
Frogs appear at edge - only one pair this time
Cleaves from boss and 2 ADS again at the end
